description:
Blocks Map.get/2,3 and Keyword.get/2,3 -- both are in fz-5xp scope.

src/compiler2/quoted_function.rs:1656
  fn is_access_get(base, field) -> bool {
      is_alias(base) && field.atom_name().ok().as_deref() == Some("get")
  }

It matches ANY alias whose called field is 'get', not just Access. frontdoor.rs:866
builds Access.get for lhs[key], and this predicate then routes every <Alias>.get/2 to
MapIndex.

VERIFIED at 67e09d373:
  defmodule Foo do
    @spec get(any, any) :: integer
    fn get(_a, _b), do: 99
  end
  fn main(), do: dbg(Foo.get(%{a: 1}, :a))    # prints 1, not 99

The user's function is never called and there is no diagnostic. Any module defining
get/2 is silently unreachable.
title: Alias.get/2 is silently hijacked into a map index
